svg.title: Two fates of free glutamine in soy-sauce moromi
svg.desc: Glutamine is converted by glutaminase to glutamic acid, or cyclises without an enzyme to pyroglutamic acid. The amide group of glutamine and the matching groups in the products are highlighted.
svg.text: no enzyme: the chain closes into a ring
if glutamine is not converted in time
Highlighted: the amide group of glutamine and the groups it becomes.
